what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in Burundi, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 109885 of these refugees in Burundi, 9.3% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the country, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in several periods since 1964, at war level in many years, and in every year from 2016 to 2025.
From 2016 to 2025 the opponents it records include Kamuina Nsapu, RNL, CNPSC and M23, and it also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1964 at 20000 refugees and was much lower by 1972.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1988 to 1989 and 2016 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Burundi.
These are year-end totals for Burundi only, reported to UNHCR.
